subject: Supplier onboarding: tax forms and PO intake (next steps)
thread_body:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamal Thomas <jamal.thomas@safepay.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: tax forms and PO intake (next steps)

Hi Jamal —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Inference. We're excited to get Safepay set up as a vendor so we can issue the PO and start the onboarding credits next week. To keep procurement moving, can you please send the following as attachments to this thread: 

- Completed W-9 (or W-8BEN-E if applicable)
- VAT registration certificate (if you invoice from an EU/UK entity)
- Remittance details (bank wiring instructions or ACH form)

Quick ask on timing: if we can receive the docs by EOD Monday (07/14), finance will issue PO PO-4829 by Wednesday and we can kick the onboarding call on Thursday.

Cc'ing Dev (procurement) and Laura (finance) to confirm any additional fields we need on the W-9 and to confirm payment terms. If you have a vendor portal or a preferred form, send that too.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

--

Hi Grace —

Thanks — happy to get this over. We are US-based (Safepay, Inc.) so W-9 will be correct. I'll pull our latest W-9 and VAT (we don't usually have VAT for US entity but will include a certificate from our EU billing arm if that helps).

Two quick clarifications:
1) Who should the remittance be addressed to on the wire instructions?
2) Do you require vendor registration in your portal or is emailed paperwork sufficient for PO issuance?

I'll aim to send the files by Monday morning.

Best,
Jamal Thomas
Director, Vendor Operations
Safepay, Inc.
jamal.thomas@safepay.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: tax forms and PO intake (next steps)

Hi Jamal —

Quick answers to your questions:
- Please address remittance to Safepay, Inc. (the name you invoice under). Include tax ID/EIN on the wire form if available.
- We can accept emailed PDFs for initial PO issuance, but if you have a vendor portal with a unique vendor ID, please share it and we'll create the vendor there too.

Also to keep PO processing fast, please confirm the full legal name for invoicing (exactly as it appears on the W-9), EIN, billing address, and a suggested remit-to reference (e.g., invoice number or contract id). If you have payment terms other than Net 30, note them here so finance can review.

Thanks — looping Laura for PO approval.

- Dev
Procurement Operations
procurement@redwoodinference.com

--

From: Jamal Thomas <jamal.thomas@safepay.com>

Thanks everyone — attaching the requested files here.

Attachments:
- Safepay_W9.pdf (attached)
- Safepay_VAT_certificate.pdf (attached; EU billing group)

Vendor details for PO: 
- Legal name: Safepay, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Billing address: 400 Harbor Drive, Suite 200, San Diego, CA 92101
- Remit to: Safepay, Inc. / Wire: Bank of Pacific / Account ending 4321 (full instructions in attached stub)
- Preferred terms: Net 30 standard; can accept Net 45 for first invoice if needed.

We do not currently have a Redwood vendor portal ID; emailed paperwork is fine. If you need anything notarized or additional W-8 forms for the EU entity, let me know.

I'll stand by for the PO number.

Regards,
Jamal Thomas
Director, Vendor Operations
Safepay, Inc.
